data.why: The repo ships small real PDB fixtures (ref.pdb/mob.pdb is the intended quickstart pair; 1crn.pdb/1ubq.pdb are unrelated single-chain structures useful for testing a mismatched-fold case) that match exactly what the uploader expects (PDB/mmCIF files).

goals: Upload a reference and a predicted/mobile structure and get RMSD, TM-score, GDT_TS and lDDT-Cα with coverage
See a plain-language verdict of how well a model matches an experimental reference, with confidence and flagged flexible regions
Inspect the 3D superposition colored by per-residue deviation to spot where a model diverges
Compare multiple predicted models against one reference as a ranked ensemble (RMSD matrix, clustering, PCA)
Score a predicted complex against a reference interface with DockQ/CAPRI class and epitope precision-recall-F1
Export a reproducible bundle (aligned structure, CSV, plots, PyMOL/ChimeraX scripts, report) for the comparison

review.summary: The tree gets the purpose and the sidebar-to-verdict path right, and its labels, screens and replayed numbers mostly hold up. But a dependency crash in this run's setup hid every result view (3D, per-residue, ensemble, interface evaluation, export), so half of what the README says the tool is for is missing. It needs a fixed environment, a multi-chain test file and a re-explore before filing.
